Design: 20 experiments per edited hyperparameter. Each set starts from a central base configuration (alpha=4.64e-06, batch=25, depth=2, lr=0.00167, width=101). From there I vary one other hyperparameter at a time to its low and high extreme, place the edited parameter itself at low and high grid positions, and add 9 shared multi-factor combinations. This isolates which bands change each edit's effect.
